Fiorentina 2-2 Juve

Vicario’s pride and rage
The goalkeeper saves twice on a draw that could have been the third win in a row if the referee had punished the handball in the box by Bianconeri loanee Joao Mario. Pellegrino, taken off Carnevali, and ex-Granata Njie score after Woltemade’s goal. Spalletti’s ironic about the penalty, but admits: ‘We lose ourselves too easily.’ Gatti with the national team.
Lazio remain at the top, but are disappointed; Lang’s case at Napoli

Como? No, Inter!
Honest Fabregas accepts the defeat: ‘The Nerazzurri are stronger and better than us, who made too many mistakes. We must bounce back now.’
Milan are in the Champions League spots by the skin of their teeth.
